\S+)\s+--\s+(?P.*\S)\s*$') coll = re.compile(r'^collected\s+(?P\d+)\s+items?\b(?P.*)$') kvre = re.compile(r'^(?P[A-Za-z][\w ]*?):\s+(?P.*\S)\s*$') rule = re.compile(r'^[=_\-]{3,}(?P.*?)[=_\-]{3,}$') timing = re.compile(r'^(?P.*?)\s+in\s+(?P[\d.]+s)\b(?P.*)$') sess = {} sess_lines = [] rows = [] row_lines = [] skip = [] cur = None for i, l in enumerate(lines): s = l.strip() if not s: continue m = hdr.match(l) if m: cur = {'fixture': m.group('name'), 'scope': m.group('scope') or 'function', 'location': m.group('loc'), 'line': m.group('lineno') or '', 'description': ''} rows.append(cur) row_lines.append(i) continue if l[:1] in (' ', '\t') and cur is not None: cur['description'] = (cur['description'] + ' ' + s).strip() row_lines.append(i) continue cur = None m = rule.match(s) if m: t = m.group('t').strip() mt = timing.match(t) if mt: sess['result'] = mt.group('res').strip() sess['duration'] = mt.group('t') sess_lines.append(i) else: skip.append(i) continue m = plat.match(s) if m: sess['platform'] = m.group('p') sess['versions'] = m.group('v') sess_lines.append(i) continue m = coll.match(s) if m: sess['collected'] = int(m.group('n')) sess_lines.append(i) continue m = kvre.match(s) if m: sess[m.group('k')] = m.group('v') sess_lines.append(i) continue blocks = [] if sess: blocks.append({'name': 'session', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': sess_lines, 'records': [sess]}) if rows: blocks.append({'name': 'fixtures', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': row_lines, 'records': rows}) return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
